entities.summary: Kaan, a notable figure in the history of Mexico, associated with Classic Maya in Mexican Territory (500–800). Preceded by Calakmul — Snake Dynasty Superpower and Janaab Pakal. Their legacy influenced Terminal Classic and Puuc Style.
